$comment: Recommended default, superseding mitre-f3-technique-flat for a new F3 set. Preserves its ontology, technique filenames, managed fields, user-preserved fields, prose and Apache attribution. Sub-technique parents derive from the dotted Technique ID; top-level techniques emit no parent. One tag per source-asserted Tactic Name creates a hub per multi-member tactic, replacing the separate demo Tactics import. Children lists are sorted by identity. Parent CURIEs use the unqualified mitre-f3 scheme; as with the ATT&CK linked recipe, a second qualified set does not rebase that explicit parent prefix.
